perspectives.title: AI Coding

representative_posts.author: novadragon.space
representative_posts.text: very annoyed right now at the notion that there is responsible AI usage in coding. coming along with the notion that many software engineers dont really like coding, but rather the architecting, and that of course its alright if the AI does the grunty busywork

representative_posts.text: I honestly do not care if AI is used during the coding process, just that it appears nowhere as an *user feature*. Or at least fucking make it opt in.

representative_posts.text: Never gives me positive hope for the ai future when so many ppl are going "ur fic was probs already scrapped so who cares what ai it goes into fuck authors for being so entitled" like uhh and so much turning to vibe coding immediately

representative_posts.author: teeklin.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: athenya.gay
representative_posts.text: "Wow look at how good AI is for coding" and it's just literally just 80% someone else's code and the nyo might think the last 20% is still impressive, but nyo have to remember genAI love to inflate how many lines of code it wrote :V

perspectives.title: Patrick Stewart
perspectives.summary: Patrick Stewart was a great person and actor

representative_posts.author: funsizela.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a wonderful human being. He taught us to see the humanity in others, to cherish time, to laugh with ease, and follow the fucking prime directive. Cheers to an amazingly great life lived by an amazingly great human being.

representative_posts.author: bluizu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i wasn't too clued into who patrick stewart was (not a star trek guy), but he seemed like a wonderful person and i do mourn the loss of another dot of kindness on the globe

representative_posts.author: ckaiadn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart 💙 Absolute legendary actor and had a great sense of humor.

representative_posts.author: broadiethornton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart, I've just come to understand, has died. A fantastically gifted actor who will be remembered for decades to come on account of various roles he so skillfully occupied. Captain Picard. Professor X.

representative_posts.author: urokialreadyknow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86. Here are just a few of his roles... #rip

representative_posts.author: shesharkattack.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: richarddominic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tonight has been a lot of reskeeting of positive Patrick Stewart. I’ve no special story or connection of my own. I’m just very, deeply sad that we’ve lost a good man a great actor and a beacon of hope. Professor X, Captain Picard, stand for a better world. So did Patrick Stewart. Salut, Mon Capitain

representative_posts.author: decemberrain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Man, not Patrick, damn. That one hits hard. Patrick Stewart was such a gentleman, the world feels less right without him in it. Mark, are you up on your checkups?

representative_posts.author: ez-ez.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart has always been an actor I loved seeing no matter what role he played. In and out of film, he was inspiring, and it's sad to learn that he is gone.

representative_posts.author: anniehzimmerman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 😔💔 Completely lost for words. Patrick Stewart is an incredible Actor. He will live on forever though his work & in all his family, friends & Fans hearts forever 💕. Rip Sir Patrick Stewart 🖖💐

representative_posts.author: trythisagain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart! It's been a hard month for old Star Trek actors.

representative_posts.author: darickr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: All I can say is fuck the grim reaper and his fucked up priorities. I am proud to have met Sir Patrick Stewart, and to know he genuinely, expressly, loved my work the way I loved his. What a gutting loss.

representative_posts.author: monicaanneheart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart died today. That is just one of those things that I thought was never going to happen. He made this world a better place...

representative_posts.author: johanlenaerts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart. You will forever be an inspiration to many across the globe, both in character and out.

representative_posts.author: benkeiser.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What a life ❤️‍🩹 I got to hear Patrick Stewart speak before a screening of Logan at the 2017 Savannah Film Festival and he was effortlessly charming and unassumingly sincere. Rest in peace, Sir 🫡

representative_posts.author: elittlechild.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The character I’ll always remember Sir Patrick Stewart for is far less known but all the more special 💔🕊️💔🕊️

representative_posts.author: milopoint.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a Shakespearean-trained actor who suffered through some horrible television writing, so I guess I can suffer fools here in this purgatory.

representative_posts.author: larrin86.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For anyone who would like to honor both Patrick Stewart and the season 😱

representative_posts.author: toasty.cx
representative_posts.text: kind of heartwarming that I have seen so much love and support for Sir Patrick Stewart's legacy and career on the timeline, including statements from fellow actors and actresses, and yet not one person has posted a screenshot of the statement I'm sure Wil Wheaton's made I love you all for this 🩵🩵🩵

representative_posts.author: sandeelovas.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My thoughts on the passing of the great Sir Patrick Stewart. Please give it a watch and subscribe to my new channel about art, writing, and all things creative. Remembering Sir Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: kq5.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my 2 years on BS, today's the 1st time I've seen the top 2 trending topics the same, "Patrick Stewart dies". He was important, not just as a TV character who portrayed a fine example of humanity, but in real life he was an advocate for the downtrodden; women abused by men. A true hero. 💔🖖

representative_posts.author: phoebe96.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart was a gentleman ... something a certain orange boil will never be RIP Captain 🖖✨️

representative_posts.author: gwiss.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m very grateful we got this awesome moment (in an otherwise crappy movie) before Patrick Stewart passed.

representative_posts.author: davidmastio.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I really liked Patrick Stewart, but not enough to have something smart to say about his passing.

representative_posts.author: alapidis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The outpouring of love, memories and sadness, for the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart on Bluesky warms my heart.

representative_posts.author: audieklotz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Never knew much about Patrick Stewart beyond the stardom and am learning only now about his other career of working to protect women and children from domestic violence ❤️‍🩹

representative_posts.text: I've been trying to think of the words to express how I feel about the passing of Patrick Stewart. All I can think is that for 7 years plus, Jean Luc Picard and his crew were my family. I know it was just a tv show, but I knew them better than my extended family. I'm truly crushed. RIP my Captain.

representative_posts.author: gojirra.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart. I need to go watch "The Inner Light" again. One of the best episodes of TNG, and a story that stays with you forever.

representative_posts.author: robinince.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So many lovely quotes and clips of Patrick Stewart going up on this sad night

representative_posts.author: rivelbee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just found out about the terrible news, and my heart fucking sank ;-; Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart, we lost another legend today ;-; ❤️

representative_posts.text: I wrote Sir Patrick Stewart into this Daily Show piece on a whim, and he actually agreed to it. He never even looked mildly perturbed at the amount of time he had to stand around in a foil-covered box. RIP to a man who was as good a sport as he was an actor.

representative_posts.author: opheliaspectre.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart passing is really fucking me up He was part of my childhood when my sister and I only had the original X-Men dvd. We watched the fuck out of it. RIP Sir Patrick Stewart. You will be missed greatly.

representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart’s Greatest Picard Moments in STAR TREK

representative_posts.author: nolongersms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I swear to god <redacted> - I'm in my sads about Patrick Stewart. Don't be offering me this. I just did a rewatch less than a couple of months ago.

representative_posts.author: antheabutler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm going to need a couple of days to get over Patrick Stewart being gone. I can't wrap my head around this

representative_posts.author: effendancie.blacksky.app
representative_posts.text: On a whim, two dear Trekkie friends and I flew to Colorado in 2023 to see Patrick Stewart on his book tour. He recited my favorite sonnet (116) and told us to be braver. More than anything from that night, I’ll remember him as a consummate storyteller. Peace to you, Sir Patrick, and thanks.

The posts defend it in their own words. @dicknixon.bsky.social writes, “When the Brewers arrived back in Milwaukee their buses avoided the interstate and instead drove through the city to see the banners, decorations, etc.” @govevers.wisconsin.gov writes, “Our Brewers are a special team, and winning the World Series means so much to Wisconsin.” @peggystuart.bsky.social writes, “MILWAUKEE BREWERS WIN THEIR FIRST WORLD SERIES: Democrat David Crowley was “instrumental” in negotiating the American Family Field deal that will keep the Brewers in Milwaukee until 2050. This is the kind of leadership he'll bring as Wisconsin's next governor. #BlueWaveIn5Days”

Culture.name: Patrick Stewart

perspectives.title: Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: funsizela.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a wonderful human being. He taught us to see the humanity in others, to cherish time, to laugh with ease, and follow the fucking prime directive. Cheers to an amazingly great life lived by an amazingly great human being.

representative_posts.author: shesharkattack.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: ckaiadn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart 💙 Absolute legendary actor and had a great sense of humor.

representative_posts.author: decemberrain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Man, not Patrick, damn. That one hits hard. Patrick Stewart was such a gentleman, the world feels less right without him in it. Mark, are you up on your checkups?

representative_posts.author: urokialreadyknow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86. Here are just a few of his roles... #rip

representative_posts.author: darickr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: All I can say is fuck the grim reaper and his fucked up priorities. I am proud to have met Sir Patrick Stewart, and to know he genuinely, expressly, loved my work the way I loved his. What a gutting loss.

representative_posts.author: monicaanneheart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart died today. That is just one of those things that I thought was never going to happen. He made this world a better place...

representative_posts.author: johanlenaerts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart. You will forever be an inspiration to many across the globe, both in character and out.

representative_posts.author: anniehzimmerman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 😔💔 Completely lost for words. Patrick Stewart is an incredible Actor. He will live on forever though his work & in all his family, friends & Fans hearts forever 💕. Rip Sir Patrick Stewart 🖖💐

representative_posts.author: anygoodfilms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Our tribute to the late great Patrick Stewart as we take a look at his life and career.... #RIPPatrickStewart

representative_posts.author: richarddominic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tonight has been a lot of reskeeting of positive Patrick Stewart. I’ve no special story or connection of my own. I’m just very, deeply sad that we’ve lost a good man a great actor and a beacon of hope. Professor X, Captain Picard, stand for a better world. So did Patrick Stewart. Salut, Mon Capitain

representative_posts.author: benkeiser.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What a life ❤️‍🩹 I got to hear Patrick Stewart speak before a screening of Logan at the 2017 Savannah Film Festival and he was effortlessly charming and unassumingly sincere. Rest in peace, Sir 🫡

representative_posts.author: larrin86.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For anyone who would like to honor both Patrick Stewart and the season 😱

representative_posts.author: markhavenbritt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It is a sad day but all of these Patrick Stewart stories and clips are bring me a lot of joy. Like out side of his death, today sucked for me. But as he has throughout his life, he’s really lifted my spirits. What a good man.

representative_posts.author: humonculuss.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I honestly don't even know what to say... rip Patrick Stewart 💔🥀

representative_posts.author: sandeelovas.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My thoughts on the passing of the great Sir Patrick Stewart. Please give it a watch and subscribe to my new channel about art, writing, and all things creative. Remembering Sir Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: robinince.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So many lovely quotes and clips of Patrick Stewart going up on this sad night

representative_posts.author: toasty.cx
representative_posts.text: kind of heartwarming that I have seen so much love and support for Sir Patrick Stewart's legacy and career on the timeline, including statements from fellow actors and actresses, and yet not one person has posted a screenshot of the statement I'm sure Wil Wheaton's made I love you all for this 🩵🩵🩵

representative_posts.author: davidmastio.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I really liked Patrick Stewart, but not enough to have something smart to say about his passing.

representative_posts.author: elittlechild.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The character I’ll always remember Sir Patrick Stewart for is far less known but all the more special 💔🕊️💔🕊️

representative_posts.author: rivelbee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just found out about the terrible news, and my heart fucking sank ;-; Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart, we lost another legend today ;-; ❤️

representative_posts.author: milopoint.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a Shakespearean-trained actor who suffered through some horrible television writing, so I guess I can suffer fools here in this purgatory.

representative_posts.author: antheabutler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm going to need a couple of days to get over Patrick Stewart being gone. I can't wrap my head around this

representative_posts.author: kq5.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my 2 years on BS, today's the 1st time I've seen the top 2 trending topics the same, "Patrick Stewart dies". He was important, not just as a TV character who portrayed a fine example of humanity, but in real life he was an advocate for the downtrodden; women abused by men. A true hero. 💔🖖

representative_posts.author: gwiss.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m very grateful we got this awesome moment (in an otherwise crappy movie) before Patrick Stewart passed.

representative_posts.author: alapidis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The outpouring of love, memories and sadness, for the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart on Bluesky warms my heart.

representative_posts.author: audieklotz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Never knew much about Patrick Stewart beyond the stardom and am learning only now about his other career of working to protect women and children from domestic violence ❤️‍🩹

representative_posts.author: dankmccoy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I wrote Sir Patrick Stewart into this Daily Show piece on a whim, and he actually agreed to it. He never even looked mildly perturbed at the amount of time he had to stand around in a foil-covered box. RIP to a man who was as good a sport as he was an actor.

representative_posts.author: thorayeen.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart Sadly missed you were every bit the man your characters were and more on top of that.

representative_posts.author: ked1994.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: An accurate depiction of how I'm feeling in response to the news of Patrick Stewart's passing

representative_posts.author: nolongersms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I swear to god <redacted> - I'm in my sads about Patrick Stewart. Don't be offering me this. I just did a rewatch less than a couple of months ago.

representative_posts.author: gojirra.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart. I need to go watch "The Inner Light" again. One of the best episodes of TNG, and a story that stays with you forever.

representative_posts.author: thesarahjames.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: can't believe patrick stewart died and i had to read the sentence "all-in podcast midterms live stream featuring taylor lorenz, brought to you by polymarket" both in one day

representative_posts.author: opheliaspectre.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart passing is really fucking me up He was part of my childhood when my sister and I only had the original X-Men dvd. We watched the fuck out of it. RIP Sir Patrick Stewart. You will be missed greatly.

representative_posts.author: brezwrites.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I never interviewed Patrick Stewart, sadly, but I want to join the outpouring of affection for him. Once, at an award season party at the San Vicente Bungalows I saw him grab onto a tree branch and start doing pull-ups. This was only a few years ago. He was formidable to the end.

representative_posts.author: thebcomp.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've been trying to think of the words to express how I feel about the passing of Patrick Stewart. All I can think is that for 7 years plus, Jean Luc Picard and his crew were my family. I know it was just a tv show, but I knew them better than my extended family. I'm truly crushed. RIP my Captain.

representative_posts.text: Man. Mainer here. We had ONE group of kids! I always prepare with lots of candy for them...and they never show up! You're killin it

representative_posts.author: stevebuchheit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And now I don’t care. Everybody who comes up gets candy. Old, young, costume or not, “extra for their kid brother who couldn’t come out”, everybody gets candy for as long as the candy holds out. I’ll joke with the kids I think can take it, but even the nonverbal ones will get a handful of candy.

perspectives.brief: People give out candy on Halloween. strangers give kids candy. everybody gets candy. parents eat their kid's candy. people give out non-candy items to parents.
perspectives.detail:
Halloween Candy argues that People give out candy on Halloween. strangers give kids candy. everybody gets candy. parents eat their kid's candy. people give out non-candy items to parents. some people are stingy with candy.

The posts defend it in their own words. @daytonward.bsky.social writes, “Without any kids to help, I had to bring a flunky to help pass out candy.” @angrybooklady.bsky.social writes, “I just need the candy out of my house, I don't care who takes it from me” @wafflicious.bsky.social writes, “The only requirement we have is that you come to the door and want candy. Every year we give some to some of the adults that come with their kids as well, everyone should get some free candy from time to time.”

Inside Halloween Candy, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

perspectives.title: Trick or Treat

representative_posts.author: lurkermclurkface.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Kids came up and said, "trick or treat," so I showed them a card trick, wished them a happy Halloween, and shut my door. I've never seen more confused faces in my life. 😂

representative_posts.author: finnanhaddie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So many families bring their kids to my street for trick-or-treating that the city started closing it to cars a few years ago & it’s great. I no longer have to worry when I see a kid dart across the street because they spotted a friend.

representative_posts.author: jonathanstegall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Normally nobody trick or treats on my street, ever, for reasons I don’t understand (although we always took our kid to other neighborhoods with his friends so maybe that’s why). This year we’ve had like five or six groups of kids. Unprecedented.

representative_posts.author: alandria.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I got all dressed up and bought candy for #Halloween. Our complex had a lot of trick or treaters. But I was not aware that kids knock on houses but don't go inside stairwell buildings?! We did not get one single kid knocking on our door, and now we have an excessive amount of candy at home. 🙃

representative_posts.author: cuddlyonmain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My neighbors used to get grumbly about older kids trick or treating. But we lived next to a rougher area, so the kids would come to our street because it was safe and everyone was nice. The older kids deserve to have fun too.

representative_posts.author: debinthecle.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: poopfoot.bsky.social

perspectives.brief: Let kids be kids on Halloween.
perspectives.detail:
Trick Treaters argues that Let kids be kids on Halloween.

The posts defend it in their own words. @scarnecchia.net writes, ““Happy Halloween! What are you?” Kid 1 (age 7-8 ish): I’m a banana! (Is clearly a banana) Kid 2 (around the same age): I’m a flowergirl! Who died at the wedding! (is in a dress that is covered in fake blood) Dad, dressed as a banana, quickly: That’s not my kid” @annebornschein.bsky.social writes, “My parents had my sister when I was 15, and I remember being SO happy to take her around the neighborhood because it let me extend trick or treating past the age deemed socially acceptable, with no side-eyeing.” @cuddlyonmain.bsky.social writes, “My neighbors used to get grumbly about older kids trick or treating. It is so much fun! 🎃 Tonight is Halloween, so it’s the last night, until next year! Hope you have a beautiful, restful day, dear one💖😘 Love you💖😘💖🫂💖 ❤️💜💙💚💛🧡🫶🏻❣️

representative_posts.author: andymightbeme.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nice night to stare at a fire.

representative_posts.author: nastr0nd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Worst thing about the nightlife in my city is everything is a ticketed event so if you want to do anything on a whim or last minute ur screwed. BORING!

representative_posts.author: lilweird2-0.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Right, I'm out of here for the night. Got myself to do and no one to see 😈💦 I'll hopefully be back tomorrow to bless your feed hehe 🤭 Goodnight and wet dreams 💋💋💦💦

representative_posts.author: d-blue02.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Happy Devil's Night

representative_posts.author: evetetra.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Can't wait for 3pm night time!!!!!

representative_posts.author: asimongardner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: …a great little night out.. here’s one especially just for you 🙏 (Didn’t get a chat afterwards unfortunately we had to head sharpish)

representative_posts.author: cherylrofer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: But oh those summer nights! I loved waking up to full sunshine and birds singing at 5 am!

representative_posts.author: kevezc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t mind it at all! I’d rather it be light in the morning than at night….. (I get up early and go to bed early.)

representative_posts.author: tjl24.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: On election night I’m gonna try to stay up as late as I possibly can!

representative_posts.author: devotedfankeith.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Quite tired tonight... Have not slept much in last few nights, inventory last night, had to get blood work done this morning then went to work on day off to finish what I did not have time to do last night.... But the highlight of week was walking out a door at work and seeing two of my fav ladies!

representative_posts.author: judepaw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: NOOOOO PEOPLE ARE SO SHITTY 😭 still, glad it was a good night overall

representative_posts.author: mlavallee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For us it's a well deserved stay at home night :) We are both exhausted and Mike is leaving for work tomorrow. Spending some time just the two of us.

representative_posts.author: stevoyah.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Goood morning gamers. Took the day off to get some car maintenance done (usual stuff plus some recall thingy🫪) Happy friday and devils night 🌙

representative_posts.author: grryryn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stay safe lads on your busiest night. We really appreciate your year round dedication, but particularly this evening, when mere mortals like me, would whimper and cower at being sent out on duty.

representative_posts.author: stefb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: They’re wholesome AF. I hope they have the best night.

representative_posts.author: calcioengland.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hope you had a good night Jeff!

representative_posts.author: sacreded2023.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you're not the least bit feeling like this (as we approaching Election Day),then I know which camp you're in. I'm taking Wednesday off! I'm either day drinking in celebration or in terror. I'm hoping for a good Tuesday night...right?!

representative_posts.author: mrulity.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Oh Shit!!! i forgot to post a Goodnight post last night before sleep... damn! i forgot that, oh well... Today is Saturday Morning, and it's Halloween Today... so, nothing i could do but posting a Sergeant Cost(Cpt. Price's Lost Brother) lol Good Morning, fellow human friends!!!🌄 #JustJaidenThings

representative_posts.author: cuddlebitch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Truly remarkable the psychic toll planning a trip back to Alberta for Christmas is taking on me. Really could not be less thrilled about the idea of being back for, as chatgpt helpfully characterized it "21 nights"

representative_posts.author: sunnydlite.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: But damn, dude. It being the dead of night when I leave work at 5pm is kicking my ass.

representative_posts.author: redroach67.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Time to get serious. I celebrated a bit too much last night. Got so high I could time travel. Scary evening when I was pretty sure that I arrived home from my inlaws house 10 minutes before I left. I was walking. I never drive altered

representative_posts.author: debknox521.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Happy Friday Night BlueSky. If I don’t get off this computer My hubby of nearly 45 years is gonna die of loneliness, ignoring his pleas for hugs. Keep fighting. Counting down the days. We got this 🗳️💙🌊💙🌊🗳️

representative_posts.author: lubbockyachtclub.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm in the top 5% of pain enjoyers on this beautiful Friday night

representative_posts.author: zayzid.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Last night was a movie

representative_posts.author: rhymepix.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tonight is a “get high and play 40k Darktide” type of night i think
